newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow to announce Eurobond roadshow date soon.
newsitem.headline: Moscow to announce Eurobond roadshow date soon.

text.p: The City of Moscow, which plans to issue its debut Eurobond, will announce the dates of the roadshow at the end of the week, Moscow municipal loans department head Mechislav Klimovich said on Tuesday.
"We have decided with our lead managers that they will make the annoucement at the end of the week," he told Reuters.
CS First Boston and Nomura International will both underwrite the issue.

President Boris Yeltsin issued a decree last week limiting the total debts of Moscow, St Petersburg and Nizhny Novgorod regional governments to 30 percent of their revenues and total debt service charges to 15 percent of non-debt revenues.
Western bankers expect Moscow to issue a bond for up to $500 million.
